content_system_application.question_unit: What changed in ReadMD v2.3.7-beta.4 and how should it be evaluated safely?
content_system_application.solution_unit: Review presentation isolation, SHA-256 update flow, startup loading, tab state, touch targets, checksums, and platform packages before installation.
content_system_application.duplicate_decision: Distinct from the GitHub Discussion: this is the localized canonical website answer for version-specific search intent.

transmission_review.silence_spiral: Users fear updates will silently rewrite files, weaken local boundaries, or break presenting.
transmission_review.framing: Stand beside users whose Markdown remains canonical and make safety checks part of installation.
transmission_review.two_step_flow: First communicators are technical writers, academic users, maintainers, and support engineers testing platform packages.
transmission_review.cognitive_consistency: Confirm local control while challenging users to verify checksums and review converted structure.
transmission_review.avoid: No formal-release claim, no perfect-conversion promise, and no unsupported performance number.

evidence: Four localized pages target version-specific ReadMD beta.4 release-note intent without duplicating the generic homepage.
Each page has a unique canonical URL, hreflang set, title, description, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList, speakable selector, and PNG social metadata.
Home, workflow, download, sitemap, llms.txt, and llms-full surfaces link all four canonical paths.
The pages distinguish beta from production readiness and instruct backup plus checksum verification.

Presentation isolation, update temporary-file and SHA-256 flow, atomic publication, pre-execution recheck, argument-vector installer, tab state, startup loading, and touch-target claims match the published Release API body.
Platform coverage includes Windows, Intel and Apple Silicon macOS, Linux x86_64, UOS, Kylin AMD64/ARM64, and the HarmonyOS source-project boundary.
Website validator passes 44 canonical URLs including four localized release-notes answers and three recorded approval rounds.
Browser smoke and clean-network production checks are expanded to all forty-four localized route variants.
Release API confirms v2.3.7-beta.4 is published with eleven assets and the linked checksum manifest returns HTTP 200.

conditions: Production check must verify all forty-four localized route variants.
IndexNow must be resubmitted after a successful production deployment.
